title.es: Aquel de la despedida de Bianca

description.es: En la casa grande, Marta recibe la visita de Doña Clara, quien le anuncia la próxima lectura del testamento de Pelayo. Más tarde, en el despacho, Marta conversa con Bianca, quién le comparte lo felices que eran Fina y ella viviendo en Argentina, Marta le recalca que ella se siente afortunada de tener a Fina a su lado. Al llegar Fina, Marta las deja solas y Bianca se despide con un abrazo que revive la complicidad entre ellas.
description.en: At the big house, Marta receives a visit from Doña Clara, who announces the upcoming reading of Pelayo's will. Later, at the office, Marta talks with Bianca, who shares with her how happy she and Fina were living in Argentina. Marta stresses that she feels fortunate to have Fina by her side. When Fina arrives, Marta leaves them alone, and Bianca says goodbye with an embrace that revives the closeness between them.
